This compound further targets Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 8, indicating a chain of interactions that could explain the observed scores. The cumulative evidence supports a pathway where Schizopeptin 791 may influence the activity of Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 8 through the activation of Sphingosine 1-phosphate receptors. The strength of the relationship is supported by multiple paths, but the exact mechanism of action remains partially understood, with further research needed to elucidate the precise role of each intermediate in the pathway.
